mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, which reduces discount rates on future corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive in periods when FEDFUNDS declines, as measured by a t-test p-value > 0.05 against zero mean return.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll growth above 200k per month signals strong labor market demand, which supports consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in less than 50% of instances when PAYEMS exceeds 200.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both housing starts and real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) indicates broad-based demand strength, which signals improving corporate earnings momentum and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when both HOUST and RSAFS rise, or the joint signal has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below its 12-month moving average indicates weakening supply-side activity, which signals economic slowdown risk and triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in less than 50% of triggered instances, or the signal fails to outperform baseline in a walk-forward Rank IC test (IC < 0.03).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 0.5% per annum signals a tightening monetary policy regime, which increases discount rates on equity cash flows and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when FEDFUNDS exceeds 0.5%, or the signal has a Rank IC < -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) and GDP growth (GDPC1) indicates weakening aggregate demand, which signals deteriorating corporate revenue outlook and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both RSAFS and GDPC1 decline, or the joint signal has a Rank IC < -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 5.0% combined with stagnant payroll growth signals labor market deterioration, which reduces consumer confidence and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both UNRATE > 5.0 and PAYEMS growth < 0.1%, or the interaction signal has a Rank IC < -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below 105.0 (index 2017=100) indicates a contraction in manufacturing output, which signals economic slowdown and triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative when INDPRO falls below 105.0, or the signal fails to achieve a Rank IC > -0.03 in walk-forward testing.
